comment: Ids check-ids.mjs flags that pack code still has. Each id has its own reason. Remove the id and its reason in the same commit as the pack fix. A line without a specific reason does not suppress the finding. Most new lines are Java names in regexes or lists (dead_bush, note_block) or a sound missing from the pinned bedrock-samples list. Do not globally suppress a kind.

Java color-bed id. Bedrock has one minecraft:bed, so this special case never runs. W9/O47 owns the BlockPlacer rewrite. Not a universal minecraft: exception.

reasons.packs/build_bp/scripts/core/BlockDestroy: Unconfirmed Java-style id in BlockDestroyer. W9/O49 owns this pack line. Kept until that edit; not silenced by a prefix exception.
reasons.packs/build_bp/scripts/main.js|eb:destro: Build mode id compared with typeId. It is not an entity, item, or block. Known false positive until the comparison is narrowed.
reasons.packs/translucent_bp/entities/player.jso: Vanilla player.json damage domain copied from Mojang, not an entity id. False positive. Do not delete the vanilla copy to silence it.
reasons.packs/atlas_bp/scripts/main.js|dead_bush: Java name dead_bush in a classifier regex or block list. Bedrock id is deadbush, often already beside it. The Java token never matches. Pack edit is outside W7. Not a universal prefix exception.
reasons.packs/atlas_bp/scripts/main.js|item_fram: Java name item_frame in a classifier or entity list. Bedrock block id is frame, so this token matches nothing. Pack edit is outside W7. Not a universal prefix exception.
